desired_performances: Given a monitoring dashboard, interpret degradation signals, differentiate likely causes, and propose a response action.

objectives.performance: Interpret degradation signals from a monitoring dashboard
conditions: Given a monitoring dashboard with performance metrics
Metrics may include accuracy, latency, error rates, and distribution shifts
success_criteria: Describes the severity and trend of degradation
Distinguishes normal variance from meaningful degradation

assumption_notes: Assumed learner needs to analyze multi-metric dashboards
Assumed conceptual understanding of degradation patterns is required

objectives.performance: Differentiate likely causes of model degradation
conditions: Common causes include data drift, concept drift, training-serving skew, and system issues
success_criteria: Identifies possible root causes based on signal patterns
Distinguishes between data-related and system-related causes
Explains reasoning for each candidate cause

assumption_notes: Assumed learner needs conceptual knowledge of degradation causes
Assumed diagnostic reasoning is the primary cognitive demand

objectives.performance: Propose appropriate response actions for model degradation
conditions: Given identified degradation and likely causes
Response options may include retraining, rollback, investigation, or mitigation
success_criteria: Proposes action aligned with identified cause
Justifies the proposed action with reasoning
Considers trade-offs and risks of the action

assumption_notes: Assumed learner needs procedural knowledge of response strategies
Assumed evaluation of trade-offs is required

assessments.capability_claim: Learner can interpret degradation signals, differentiate causes, and propose response actions

required_evidence.criterion: Correctly identifies degradation from dashboard metrics
required_evidence.rationale: Demonstrates ability to interpret monitoring signals

required_evidence.criterion: Provides plausible causes with supporting reasoning
required_evidence.rationale: Shows diagnostic thinking about root causes

required_evidence.criterion: Proposes action appropriate to identified cause

task.description: Analyze a monitoring dashboard showing model performance degradation, identify likely causes, and recommend a response action with justification
conditions: Dashboard includes accuracy, latency, error rate, and input distribution metrics
Degradation pattern suggests data drift or concept drift

performance_levels: Misidentifies degradation or overlooks key signals
Identifies degradation but misses severity or trend
Accurately identifies degradation, severity, and trend
Proposes plausible causes with limited reasoning
Proposes well-reasoned causes with supporting evidence from signals
Action aligned but without trade-off consideration
Action aligned with cause and justified with trade-offs

scoring.mastery_rule: All dimensions at highest level or two at highest and one at middle level

assumption_notes: Assumed scenario-based assessment aligns with performance goal
Assumed rubric levels reflect progression in competence

prerequisites.capability: Read and interpret time-series charts and dashboards
prerequisites.rationale: Interpreting monitoring dashboards requires chart literacy

prerequisites.capability: Understand basic model performance metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, latency)
prerequisites.rationale: Identifying degradation requires understanding what metrics represent

prerequisites.capability: Understand the concept of data drift and concept drift
prerequisites.rationale: Differentiating causes requires knowledge of drift types

prerequisites.capability: Understand training-serving skew and system-level model failures
prerequisites.rationale: Diagnostic reasoning requires knowledge of non-drift failure modes

prerequisites.capability: Understand common model maintenance strategies (retraining, rollback, mitigation)
prerequisites.rationale: Proposing actions requires knowledge of available response options

sequencing_rationale: Module 1 builds dashboard interpretation skills needed for diagnosis
Module 2 develops causal reasoning using interpreted signals
Module 3 applies diagnostic understanding to decision-making
Summative assessment integrates all three modules

assumption_notes: Assumed 60-minute constraint allows three modules with practice
Assumed sequential dependency from interpretation to diagnosis to action

lessons.lesson_goal: Identify degradation signals from monitoring dashboard metrics
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Observe instructor annotation of a sample dashboard, noting which metrics indicate degradation and why

assumption_notes: Assumed demonstration supports initial pattern recognition
No formative assessment embedded; informal observation expected

lessons.lesson_goal: Practice interpreting degradation signals from dashboards
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Analyze practice dashboards and identify degradation signals with feedback

assumption_notes: Assumed guided practice consolidates interpretation skill
Formative assessment provides feedback before moving to diagnosis

lessons.lesson_goal: Understand common causes of model degradation and their signal patterns
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Study explanations of drift types, training-serving skew, and system failures with illustrative signal patterns

assumption_notes: Assumed conceptual explanation precedes diagnostic practice
No embedded assessment; checking understanding in next lesson

lessons.lesson_goal: Practice diagnosing causes from observed degradation patterns
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Follow worked examples showing diagnostic reasoning from signals to causes, then attempt similar problems

assumption_notes: Assumed worked examples scaffold diagnostic reasoning
Formative assessment checks causal differentiation before response module

lessons.lesson_goal: Understand response strategies and their trade-offs
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Study response options (retraining, rollback, investigation, mitigation) and their cost-benefit trade-offs

assumption_notes: Assumed conceptual understanding of response strategies is needed
Brief explanation due to time constraint

lessons.lesson_goal: Practice proposing and justifying response actions
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Analyze scenarios with diagnosed degradation and propose appropriate responses with justification

assumption_notes: Assumed scenario-based practice prepares for summative assessment
Formative assessment provides feedback before final evaluation
